# HPDFViewer

> Android app to read, fill in, sign and share PDFs; free; no account; files stay on the device.

HPDFViewer runs on Android 8.0 or later, on phones and tablets. The interface is in Italian and English. The app is free and shows ads; Premium is a one-time in-app purchase with no subscription. The developer is Angelo Moroni. The app is on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hooloovoochimico.hpdfviewer

## What it does

- Read: PDF pages in continuous vertical scrolling, pinch-to-zoom and double tap to zoom, one tap for full screen.
- Fill in: text in three sizes where you tap, today's date with one tap in your country's format, check marks and crosses for boxes. Move, resize and delete items; undo and redo.
- Sign: draw a signature and initials once, then insert them with one tap. They are saved encrypted on the device, and you can protect them with a fingerprint check before each signature. The free version keeps one signature and one set of initials; Premium keeps up to 3 signatures and 3 sets of initials and can sign for another person, used once and not saved (Premium).
- Pen: freehand drawing with a finger, two fingers to scroll. Four colors and three thicknesses. The eraser removes a whole stroke with one tap.
- Scan: photograph paper sheets. Edges are detected automatically, several pages are supported, and the result is a PDF ready to fill in and sign. Free. The app does not ask for camera permission.
- Pages: add pages at the end from other PDFs, images or scans. Remove pages (Premium). Reorder pages by dragging them (Premium).
- Share: one tap creates the filled copy and opens the share menu, or save the copy wherever you want. The original file is never modified.

## Availability: production and beta

The production version on Google Play does not have all features yet. These features are available now in the open beta and are coming to everyone soon: pen, document scanning, adding pages, removing and reordering pages (Premium), full-screen reading. Anyone can join the beta from https://hpdfviewer.github.io/tester.html.

## Privacy

- No account: no registration, no email address, no profile.
- No cloud: PDFs, scans and signatures never go over the internet. The app works offline.
- Encrypted signatures: signatures are stored encrypted on the device and can be protected with a fingerprint.
- Original kept intact: each share or save creates a new copy.
- Ads: the free version shows Google AdMob ads, which do not see your documents.
- Full details: https://hpdfviewer.github.io/privacy.html

## Limits

- The signature is a simple electronic signature under eIDAS, not a qualified digital signature. It does not replace a digital signature when one is expressly required.
- HPDFViewer does not fill in interactive AcroForm fields as form fields. It writes on top of the page, where you tap.
- Android only.

## FAQ

### How do you fill in and sign a PDF on Android?

Open the PDF with HPDFViewer (also directly from email, WhatsApp, Telegram or Drive), tap where you want to write and enter text, a date or check marks. Tap Sign to insert your signature, then Share: the app creates a filled copy and sends it with the app you prefer.

### Is HPDFViewer free?

Yes. Reading, filling in, signing, scanning and sharing are free, with unobtrusive ads: never full screen, never between pages, and never while you fill in or sign. Premium is a one-time purchase with no subscription. It removes the ads and adds some features.

### Are my PDFs uploaded online?

No. HPDFViewer has no accounts and never sends PDFs, scans or signatures over the network. A document leaves the phone only when you share it with another app.

### Does a signature made with HPDFViewer have legal value?

It is a simple electronic signature under the eIDAS regulation: the image of your signature drawn on the document. It is not a qualified digital signature, so it does not replace a digital signature when one is expressly required.

### Does it work with any PDF, even scanned or without fillable fields?

Yes. HPDFViewer writes on top of the page, like a pen on paper, so it also works with scanned forms and with PDFs that have no interactive fields. It does not fill in interactive form fields (AcroForm) as such: you write where you tap.

### Is the original file modified?

No, never. When you share or save, HPDFViewer always creates a new copy of the PDF with what you added.

### Can I scan a paper document?

Yes, for free. Scan document photographs the sheets, detects the edges and creates a PDF that you can fill in, sign and share right away. Pages are processed on the phone, and the app does not ask for camera permission. For now scanning is in the beta version.

### Which devices does HPDFViewer work on?

Phones and tablets with Android 8.0 or later. The app is downloaded from Google Play.

### How do you become a beta tester of HPDFViewer?

Open the Become a tester page at https://hpdfviewer.github.io/tester.html, join the test with your Google account and update the app from the Play Store: you receive the test versions before everyone else. You can leave the test at any time.
